transaction.label: Transaction
transaction.note: The deal number. Scopes the whole run to one deal.

upToDueDate.label: Up to and Including Due Date
upToDueDate.note: Selection filter. Only flows due by this date are posted - see TC-002's 'TBB1 posts only what is due by its cutoff'.

upToPostingDate.label: Up to and Incl. Posting Date
upToPostingDate.note: A second selection filter, NOT the date that stamps the document.

postingDate.label: Posting Date (Posting Control)
postingDate.note: THIS is the one that stamps the document. In the web lane both fields carry the title 'Posting Date in the Document' and are told apart only by position; in the GUI lane they are distinct ids, so the ambiguity does not arise.

testRun.label: Test Run
testRun.note: Defaults ON. Left alone, a 'post' simulates, reports success and writes nothing. Driven false and recorded; never driven true first (CLAUDE.md rule 3a).

informationOverviewGrid.label: Information Overview -> Logs and Messages
informationOverviewGrid.note: Company code 1000 returns this popup where 9800 returns an inline list. Its rows need select_table_row BEFORE double_click_table_cell - a bare double-click on an unselected row silently does nothing. @5B@ in STATE_SYMBOL is the green-light icon.
